text.card: A star about 130 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 18.1 solar radii and 4.08 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,824 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Alpha Sagittae
quotes.card: Alpha Sagittae, formally named Sham, is a single star in the northern constellation of Sagitta.
quotes.introduction: Alpha Sagittae is the Bayer designation, which is latinized from α Sagittae and abbreviated Alpha Sge or α Sge.
